clips.title: The story
paras: Salma Saldean cooks Westfall Stew on her farm, making a meal from what the frontier offers. Its ingredients reflect how Westfall homesteaders endure bandits, famine, and dangerous beasts.

Westfall's settlers contend with bandits, famine, and rampaging beasts, far from Stormwind's lavish larders. Families like the Saldeans make do with what the land provides. Salma Saldean turns ingredients many city folk might call pests or scraps into a sustaining meal for working farmhands.

Salma's recipe brings together local okra, stringy meat from circling vultures, and snouts from wild goretusks roaming the plains. It also calls for fresh murloc eyes gathered from coastal raiders. The thought of river beasts and carrion birds may turn delicate stomachs in Elwynn, but Westfall cooks swear the blend makes a rich, fortifying meal.
